An informed consent was taken from patient\/ attender and there is omission of information that was requested to be omitted.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Lato, sans-serif\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E83yr old male came with complaints of\u0026nbsp; shortness of breath since 10 days.\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003Echief\u0026nbsp; complaints:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;cough since 16 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFever since 14 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eshortness of breath since 12 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of Presenting illness:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was admitted to ICU 16 days back with\u0026nbsp; breathlessness. It was insidious in onset and gradually progressive, continuous and present during rest with no associated relieving factors. Patient's attender also complained of awakening during night due to breathlessness. No h\/o palpitations, stridor, or hoarseness of voice\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatients attender also told about\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;cough which was insidious in onset, gradually progressive associated with sputum which was white in colour ,scanty\u0026nbsp; amount, mucoid in consistency and non foul smelling\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Patient also complained of intermittent spikes of fever\u0026nbsp; since 14 days, associated with chills and rigors, not relieved on taking medication and not associated with headache, vomiting\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;No h\/o chest pain, orthopnea, PND\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o recurrent sore throat or cold\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo history of similar complaints in the past\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is N\/K\/C\/O of Hypertension, Diabetes mellitus, TB, Epilepsy, Bronchial asthma, Thyroid disorders\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o blood transfusions and surgeries\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFAMILY HISTORY: Insignificant\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eas mentioned by the attender\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet - Mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite - decreased\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep- Adequate\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and Bladder movements- Regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAddiction - consumption of alcohol occasionally,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;h\/o smoking since 30 yrs (3 packs per day) reduced to 1 pack per day since 2 yrs\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION :\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is conscious, coherent and cooperative and well oriented to time, place and person\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe is moderately built\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is presence of pallor ,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Epedal edema up to the knee\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
